runs.question: How long after OMB M-25-22 is issued does it start to apply to new AI contracts?

answer.text:
M-25-22 reaches new AI contracts 180 days after the memo is issued. It applies to any contract awarded pursuant to a solicitation issued on or after the date that is 180 days after issuance of this memorandum. The same 180-day threshold also covers any option to renew or extend the period of performance exercised on an existing contract after the date that is 180 days after the issuance of this memorandum.

The memo does not cover AI acquired for use as a component of a National Security System.
